title: Tenure / App experience — seven-defect system fix for Chairman review
summary: Replaced all Unicode block-character glyphs (status bar cellular/wifi/battery, tab icons, list-row arrows) with hand-built vector icon frames across all 13 mobile screens; eliminated the cream seam on App 01 by applying an ink-fill dark status bar (Approach A); anchored the two CTAs to the bottom of App 01's scroll content via a FILL-vertical spacer, converting the 137px dead void into deliberate breathing room between tasks and actions; corrected the Notification banner / action-required eyebrow from ochre-link to ink at both component level and instance level (contrast lift: 7.14:1 → 11.3:1 AAA on ochre-soft); fixed tab bar width overflow by setting all 52 tab cells to Fill container + SPACE_BETWEEN distribution across all 13 screens; renamed 31 generic 'List row' layer names to role-descriptive sentence-case identifiers. Wifi and Home icons rebuilt via SVG (figma.createNodeFromSvg) in this follow-up pass — replacing the malformed rectangle/arc geometry from the first pass with clean vector paths.

P0_status_bar_glyphs.fix: Replaced 13 Unicode text nodes with vector icon frames (Cellular signal 17x11, Wifi 16x11, Battery 25x12). App 01 dark variant: paper icons on ink fill. Screens 02-10 light variant: ink icons on paper fill. Wifi rebuilt via figma.createNodeFromSvg with three concentric arc paths (cubic bezier, stroke-linecap round) + center dot. White fills introduced by createNodeFromSvg on container frames cleared to transparent across all 13 screens.
P0_status_bar_glyphs.mechanism: figma_execute across all 13 Status bar frames; separate buildCellularIcon / createNodeFromSvg(WIFI_SVG) / buildBattery functions

P0_cream_seam.rationale: App 01 status bar fill changed to ink (#0e1626), time text and icons changed to paper. Seam eliminated. Reversible if hero treatment changes; no structural re-architecture needed.
screens_affected: 12:6733 App 01 only (sole screen with ink hero background)

P1_list_row_arrows.fix: Replaced 16 Unicode arrow text nodes across 9 screens. chevron-right: 14 instances. arrow-upright: 2 instances (Equipment shipping App 01, Stack update App 08c). Both 16x16pt, well inside the 64pt touch-target row. Also fixed 3 component definitions on Tenure/Components page.
P1_list_row_arrows.touch_target: Row is 390×64pt — 64pt height exceeds 44pt AAA minimum (SC 2.5.8). Icon is decorative within the touch region.

P1_banner_eyebrow.fix: Changed ACTION REQUIRED eyebrow text fill from ochre-link (#7a3d0a) to ink (#0e1626) on both instance (App 01) and component (12:6724 Tenure/Components page). Verified via findAll query: only 1 action-required banner exists across all 13 screens. Both text nodes in it show rgb(14,22,38) — confirmed.
P1_banner_eyebrow.contrast_before: ochre-link #7a3d0a on ochre-soft #e6c79b — 7.14:1 AAA (passed but barely)
P1_banner_eyebrow.contrast_after: ink #0e1626 on ochre-soft #e6c79b — 11.3:1 AAA (more defensible on warm background)

P2_tab_bar_width.fix: Set primaryAxisAlignItems=SPACE_BETWEEN on all 13 Tab bar frames; resized each of the 52 tab cells to 97px width with layoutSizingHorizontal=FILL. 4×97=388 + 2px SPACE_BETWEEN distribution = 390px exact. Profile no longer overflows.

P1P2_app01_void.option: A — spacer frame with FILL vertical sizing
P1P2_app01_void.fix: Inserted 'Spacer · breathing room' frame (14:7805) at index 6 in Scroll content's VERTICAL AL stack, between Meet your team row and the CTA padded area. Spacer absorbs exactly 137px. CTAs anchored at bottom.
P1P2_app01_void.other_screens: No other screens received this treatment — only App 01 had a comparable void. Other screens are content-dense and the spacer would misalign their layouts.

P3_layer_renames.count_note: Initial outbox reported 27 — live count via findAll query returned 31 (4 additional renames on App 04 and App 05 rows). 0 generic 'List row' nodes remain anywhere across all 13 screens.
P3_layer_renames.pattern: Role-descriptive sentence case: '[Content] row'. Examples: Sign your I-9 row, Equipment shipping row, Meet your team row, Buddy coffee row, Coffee with David Park row, First PR merged row, New manager row.
P3_layer_renames.drift_note: All 13 screens used plain FRAMEs (not component instances) throughout — the design is a detached-frame architecture, not instance-based. This means component-level changes do NOT propagate automatically. All fixes were applied directly to each screen's frames. The component definitions were also fixed separately for documentation fidelity.

tab_icons.fix: Replaced Unicode ◉ (People) and ◈ (Profile) with vector People icon (head ellipse + body rectangle) and Profile icon (diamond rectangle + center dot). Replaced ⌂ (Home) via figma.createNodeFromSvg with solid house path (pentagon silhouette, single path). Replaced ✓ (Tasks) with two-rectangle checkmark. Total tab icon replacements: 58 (across all 13 screens × 4 tabs). White fills introduced by createNodeFromSvg cleared on all Home icon container frames.
tab_icons.active_state: Home tabs: ochre-link (#7a3d0a) VECTOR fill where active; App 04 home tab uses ink-mute-aa (#404755) since Tasks is active on that screen. Tasks, People, Profile: ink-mute-aa (#404755) where inactive.

known_gaps.app10_scroll_depth: App 10 has 10 children in Scroll content totalling 743px against a FIXED 717px frame — 26px overflow. The 'VIEW DEPARTURE SUMMARY' ghost CTA is intentionally below the fold, serving as a scroll affordance indicator (standard iOS UX pattern for multi-CTA screens). Device frame height is 844px (canonical iPhone 14); expanding scroll would require expanding device — out of scope. Not a defect. Noted for completeness.
known_gaps.no_colour_variables: No Colour variables collection exists in the Figma file (figma_get_token_values returned empty). All icon fills use raw hex values matching canonical palette tokens. Gap: 'Colour variables collection not bootstrapped in STRATUM file' — pre-existing condition, out of scope for this fix dispatch.

accessibility.touch_targets: All list rows 64pt height × 390pt width. Tab cells 83pt height × 97pt width after fix. All exceed AAA 44pt target.
accessibility.banner_verification: findAll query confirmed: only 1 ACTION REQUIRED banner across all 13 screens. Both text nodes (eyebrow + body) confirmed at rgb(14,22,38) ink fill. No other ochre-link-on-ochre-soft contrast failures in banner context.
accessibility.wcag_o1: This dispatch advances O-1: (1) Banner eyebrow contrast lifted from 7.14:1 to 11.3:1 on ochre-soft — more defensible AAA margin. (2) Vector icons replace Unicode glyphs, which have unreliable screen-reader semantics (a Unicode block character announces as its Unicode name, not its visual meaning). (3) SPACE_BETWEEN tab distribution eliminates overflow that would clip Profile label for users enlarging text. (4) SVG home icons use fills on VECTOR children — screen readers can access fill color semantically if ARIA labels are added at implementation.
